title: Endpoint indicator identity for layer weights
statement:
Let $A$ be a subset of an $n$-element set, and write $w(n,k)=1/((n+1)\binom{n}{k})$. Then
\[
|A|\bigl(w(n,|A|)+w(n,|A|-1)\bigr)-(n-|A|)\bigl(w(n,|A|)+w(n,|A|+1)\bigr)=\mathbf{1}_{A=U}-\mathbf{1}_{A=\varnothing},
\]
where $U$ is the entire ground set and $\mathbf{1}_P$ is $1$ if $P$ holds and $0$ otherwise; the cardinality arguments $|A|-1$ and $|A|+1$ are understood as natural numbers.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a subset of the ground set
